line_height_rule: font size multiplied by 1.45, rounded to the nearest 4px interval
mono_use: Use for isolated numeric metrics, amounts, codes, and data-intensive views; do not use for nominal identifiers such as addresses or phone numbers.
link_rule: Embedded links in body text retain an underline; standalone actions use a link or button below the paragraph.
accessibility: Text used as a heading must expose the appropriate heading role/trait for screen-reader navigation.
